decision: Substrate controls live on a new AI Coding route /ai-coding/substrate (Sessions tab + one tab per opened session) and /ai-coding/admin, with a shared launcher (AgentLaunchDialog) wired into both existing Coding Agents layouts; substrate tabs are not added to TerminalManager.
rationale: Substrate sessions are server-persistent (dx#114): a tab is only a viewer, so reattach-on-mount is correct and TerminalManager's keep-the-socket-alive-across-navigation machinery (container semantics: closing kills) is not needed. Keeping them apart means container behaviour is unchanged.
alternatives: Add substrate sessions to TerminalManager and both layouts' tab/tree views (large blast radius on the container path, and its close = kill semantics conflict with detach-only); a separate service/app (rejected in dx#113/#123).

decision: Reuse components/terminal/Terminal.tsx with a new optional connect() prop (persistent mode) instead of a new terminal component; without connect the container path is byte-for-byte the old one.
rationale: Required by the ticket (reuse daax's xterm terminal). connect() is called on every (re)connect so each gets a fresh single-use grant from openSubstrateTerminal; in persistent mode any unrequested close is a detach and the owner decides whether to reattach (re-read state: running -> reattach, else stay detached). Retries are capped at 6 consecutive failures.
alternatives: A second xterm component (duplication); reusing the container reconnect path (it treats 1000 as a clean exit and never re-mints a substrate grant).

decision: Add PUT /api/substrate/sessions/:id/egress (running/suspended, actor-owned sessions only) using #527's validation, replacing rules with kubectl ate update egress-policy and never creating a missing policy; plus POST /api/substrate/egress/validate for inline errors.
rationale: #527 exposes no update route. Update-only (never create-if-missing, unlike harness SetEgress) means an update racing End cannot resurrect a deleted policy; the record write is guarded on state so a lost race answers 409. Updates of one session are serialized per process (single-replica web plane, as #527's inFlight).
alternatives: Delete+create the policy (a window with no policy and an orphan risk); harness SetEgress create-if-missing (orphan policy after End); client-side-only validation (would diverge from the server's validator).

decision: Provider keys are written by the web plane with kubectl server-side apply, one field manager per provider (daax-web-<secretKey>), stdin only, then last-applied annotation removal and rollout restart of the gateway; status is set/unset only. Gated by DAAX_SUBSTRATE_GATEWAY_NAMESPACE; the required RBAC (get/patch on the one Secret and Deployment) is documented, not granted, by this change.
rationale: Follows substrate-harness docs/agents.md and harness/cli.go SetKey, with the distinct-manager fix the doc calls for. The web plane has no kube access for this in the split deploy (dx#121), so it is behind config.
alternatives: One shared field manager (drops other providers' keys on apply); client-side apply (copies the key into last-applied-configuration); a harness API (paused, and the decision is daax UI).

decision: Substrate audit rows go into the existing append-only auth_audit table (event substrate.<action>), with no migration, and admins read them via GET /api/substrate/admin/audit.
rationale: No substrate audit source exists; auth_audit is the repo's append-only audit log with best-effort writes, so substrate actions sit next to authz decisions without a schema change.
alternatives: A new substrate_audit table plus a migration (more surface for the same data); deriving the audit from substrate_sessions rows (they hold no actor or attempt history).

decision: The repo/branch launcher field is optional, labelled provisional (dx#117), validated, kept only in the browser's open-tab record, and not sent to the backend.
rationale: #527 has no field for it and dx#117 is undecided (leading option agent/<name>). Sending it would imply an effect that does not exist; adding a column would pre-empt dx#117.
alternatives: Hide the field (the ticket asks for it); store it server-side (pre-empts dx#117).
